reasons: Cited text substantively meets the preferred position: 11.1 provides up to six months of transition assistance on Customer's request upon any expiry or termination (at expiring Order Form rates, no worse than then-current rates, and expressly covering knowledge transfer, export support and replacement-supplier cooperation).

11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a commonly used, documented, machine-readable format and bars withholding for fee disputes; 11.3 requires secure deletion with written officer certification, with only a narrow Applicable Law retention carve-out that remains protected and use-restricted.

Consistent with the compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the deterministic check confirms transition/data-return language is present; the finding is properly retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
Minor timing nuance (30 days runs from Customer's request rather than from termination) does not defeat compliance and would not warrant an edit.
